cover_letter:
Dear DOOR9 team,

I am applying for the Marketing & Communication internship at DOOR9 Hotel & Restaurant. I am a digital marketer working where SEO, content and web meet, and what interests me about this role is the way DOOR9 pairs a fully digital, self-service arrival with a warm, personal bar and bistro. That is a marketing story worth telling properly, and it needs someone who can hold the same tone across a website, an Instagram post, a card at reception and a reply to a guest.

At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, and I manage WordPress and Shopify stores end to end: building pages, publishing blog posts, maintaining product catalogues. I track results with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs, so I am comfortable turning campaign activity into numbers a manager can act on. I also work with GEO and AEO, making sure a business is visible not only in Google but in AI-powered search, which is where a growing share of travel research now starts.

On the content side I write and publish, and I use Canva for visuals. My background is technical - web development work and coursework in Applied Computer Science at Karel de Grote Hogeschool - which means I can fix things on a site rather than wait for someone else. I also hold Semrush SEO certifications and a Google Analytics GA4 certification.

I live in Zwijndrecht and can be on-site in Hasselt. My Dutch writing is B1 and my speaking is improving; I am happy to use it with guests and partners. Market research, guest feedback and coordination with the operations team are tasks I would take on with care - I like getting the details right.

I would be glad to talk about how I can help DOOR9's visibility and guest engagement.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
